description: Sample response for GET /conflicts?status=open — retrieves conflicts from the priority register with filtering by status per PRD. Visibility to all team members via API.

conflicts.title: Engineering Team — P0 Priority Conflict: Competing P0 requests
conflicts.description:
Conflict detected on 2025-06-23T10:30:00.000Z in version V1.
Rule: Two distinct stakeholders assigned conflicting P0 priorities to the same team within the same review window.
Details:
- Stakeholder "Alice Smith" (ID: alice) assigned priority P0 to team "Engineering Team".
- Stakeholder "Bob Johnson" (ID: bob) assigned priority P0 to the same team "Engineering Team".
Impact: Resource allocation conflict — team "Engineering Team" cannot satisfy two competing P0 priorities simultaneously. Requires manual resolution by conflict resolver.
Attached to priority version(s): V1
conflicts.summary: Conflict: Stakeholder "Alice Smith" assigned P0 and stakeholder "Bob Johnson" assigned P0 to team "Engineering Team" within same review window. Rule violation: distinct stakeholders cannot both set P0 for same team in same window; requires manual resolution. [Version: V1]

notes.labeling: Each alert includes conflicting items (priority1 vs priority2, team), involved stakeholders (stakeholders array with names/roles), and detection date (detectedAt).
notes.deduplication: If same stakeholder-pair + team + version is detected again, no new alert is created; duplicatesFound counter increments.
notes.summarization: Each alert includes a concise summary explaining the rule violation and reasoning.
notes.attachment: versionIds field attaches alerts to relevant priority version(s).
notes.visibility: Visible to all team members via GET /conflicts API. Supports filtering by status per PRD.
notes.manualResolution: Conflict resolvers can manually resolve via POST /conflicts/:id/resolve with action resolve/acknowledge/dismiss.
